text:
Ravi: quick report from the quickstart walkthrough: users see a bare "500" toast with no guidance when the model node hiccups. Noise in support is up.

Nora: thanks. is that hosted or dedicated? any sample logs?

Ravi: hosted. sample response body we saw: `{"error": "server error"}` and sometimes 503. no fields for machine parsing.

Dario: that's rough. Different SDKs treat that differently which makes sample apps behave oddly. We need a minimal, stable contract that SDKs can rely on.

Priya: what minimal fields do we want? my vote: `code`, `message`, `retryable`, `retry_after_ms?`, `user_hint?`, and `op_id?`. Keep it tiny and language-neutral.

Nora: +1. Also add `client_notice` string key (short constant) so UIs and i18n can map to localized copy later. Example shape we can show in docs (as a code sample, not live response):

```
{"error":{
  "code":"model_overloaded",
  "message":"node overloaded",
  "retryable":true,
  "retry_after_ms":5000,
  "user_hint":"Try again in a few seconds.",
  "client_notice":"TOAST_TRY_SHORT",
  "op_id":"op_7c2"
}}
```

Dario: important infra nuance: Retry-After header exists but can be in HTTP-date or stripped by proxies. Recommend `retry_after_ms` in JSON as canonical signal; header stays best-effort.

Priya: SDK behavior: do NOT auto-retry non-idempotent endpoints by default. Provide a `with_retries()` opt-in helper or a retry_policy builder. The typed error should expose `is_retryable()` and `suggested_backoff_ms()`.

Ravi: sampleapp UX idea: show a friendly toast using `user_hint` and a Retry button. If the endpoint is non-idempotent, clicking Retry prompts: "This may repeat the action. Proceed?". Also include a tiny "Report" link embedding `op_id` for support.

Nora: agree. We should also add `idempotency` metadata to our OpenAPI for each endpoint so SDKs can programmatically check whether auto-retry is safe.

Dario: docs: add a one-row matrix in onboarding mapping status+code -> default guidance. e.g. 4xx (except 429/422) -> client error no retry; 422 -> validation; 429 -> rate limit honor retry_after or backoff; 5xx/503/model_overloaded -> transient retryable by default but SDK checks idempotency.

Priya: observability: always include `op_id` in logs and Sentry. sampleapp should surface a support link prefilled with `op_id` so users can file a ticket quickly.

Ravi: action items: 1) API/infra: add minimal JSON fields (`code`, `retryable`, `retry_after_ms?`, `client_notice`, `op_id`) behind a feature flag. 2) SDKs: produce a parity ticket to expose typed error with `.code`, `.is_retryable()`, `.retry_after_ms`, `.client_notice`, `.op_id` and `with_retries()` helper. 3) Samples: render `user_hint` and provide retry UI + report link (I'll open a small PR). 4) Docs: tiny status/code -> behavior matrix in quickstart README.

Dario: I'll draft the SDK parity ticket for Python and JS and include interface examples. Priya, can you own coordination with infra for the feature flag rollout?

Priya: yep, i'll loop infra and api-design. propose landing JSON fields first behind flag, then flip on clients gradually.

CI-bot: branch `ravi/error-contract-ui` pushed  smoke tests queued.

Nora: small suggestion: separate `user_hint` vs `debug_hint` so we don't accidentally show internal troubleshooting text in the UI. `user_hint` stays short (1 sentence).

Ravi: good call. we'll include `debug_hint` for logs only.

Dario: final thought: document the recommended client patterns including examples showing opt-in retries and how to handle non-idempotent endpoints. That should reduce support noise.

Priya: will add an example in API docs and sampleapp README. aim to have the sample patch + Python SDK stub by EOW. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
